objective: Quantify how the eligible Add Noise CPU-premultiplied and Composition-resident-GPU-straight routes respond to the same premultiplied layer pixels after the GPU LayerToFloat unpremultiply-and-saturate ingress, with low alpha and HDR source values.

scope.effect: Registered Add Noise color, monochrome, and luminance equations; focus is composition ingress representation and downstream source-over response.
scope.method: Offline NumPy source-equation model of a premultiplied BGRA patch grid, CPU effect on stored premultiplied RGB, and GPU LayerToFloat followed by the resident shader on straight clamped RGB. No C++/HLSL execution, app, or GPU capture.
scope.route_assumption: This is a conditional route model based on static source tracing. It does not prove that a particular project, backend, or frame selects either route.
excluded: compiled C++/HLSL or actual CPU/GPU output parity
runtime route selection or fallback frequency
Viewer color transform or transfer-function validation
photographic ground truth or aesthetic approval
GPU/backend parity, preview/final output, temporal behavior

comparison.baseline: For each premultiplied input patch, compute a bypassed CPU source-over baseline and a GPU LayerToFloat ingress source-over baseline. Report effect deltas from each route-specific baseline as well as paired route output differences.
candidates: neutral straight source level .01, .05, .18, .5, .95, 1, 1.5, and 4, premultiplied by alpha into storage
amount 0, .2, and .4; seed 73; size 1.5; color, monochrome, and luminance-only modes
source-over composites on black, 18% gray, and white backgrounds
comparison.ground_truth: None. The synthetic numeric patch grid is a diagnostic input; route deltas reveal representation sensitivity, not which route is visually correct.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive conditional analysis only. Verify exact source markers, numeric-seed match between CPU and resident equations, GPU unpremultiply/saturate ingress, alpha identity, finite outputs, and premultiplied input construction. Report per alpha/tone/mode amount row: ingress clamp loss, stored-RGB delta, premultiplied-bound violations, route-specific effect delta, and composited route gap. No image-quality threshold or product defect declaration.

materials.fixture: A 512x512 opaque-alpha-grid arrangement of 64x64 patches covering all alpha and neutral-tone combinations. Stored source RGB is straight tone multiplied by alpha, with tone up to 4.0; alpha is held constant per patch. Noise is evaluated at global pixel coordinates with fixed seed 73.
materials.identity: Record plan, runner, Add Noise source, LayerToFloat shader, Composition controller source hashes, generated inputs, and all output hashes.

conditions.storage: Logical BGRA Float32 premultiplied source; raw stored RGB = neutral straight tone * alpha; alpha is constant within each patch.
conditions.gpu_ingress: LayerToFloat model: alpha=saturate(src.a); straight=(alpha>1e-6)?src.rgb/alpha:0; RGB=saturate(straight); alpha retained.
conditions.cpu_route: Apply CPU Add Noise directly to premultiplied stored RGB; RGB clamps per source equation; alpha remains unchanged.
conditions.gpu_route: Apply resident numeric-seed Add Noise after GPU ingress; RGB is straight and clamped by the effect; compositor multiplies RGB by alpha.
metrics: GPU ingress unpremultiplied RGB clamp delta and clipped-channel fraction
CPU/resident effect delta from each route's own bypassed baseline
stored RGB route difference and premultiplied RGB<=alpha violation fraction
composited CPU-premul versus GPU-straight MAE/RMSE/p99/max by alpha/tone/mode/amount/background
transparent-pixel stored RGB change and composited visibility
alpha identity, nonfinite values, and channel range
conditions.display: Shared clipped preview contact sheets for amount .4 color mode over black and white; raw Float32 route and delta metrics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Verify the CPU/resident Add Noise and LayerToFloat equations against source markers.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: All markers true; CPU and resident use the same numeric seed hash and size coordinates; alpha remains exact; output finite.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect low-alpha and HDR tone/contact regions over two backgrounds.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic or route preference gate.

color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual layer descriptor, compiled path, Viewer transfer function, and product compositor output.

temporal_stability.reason: Fixed seed with no frame input.

render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Whether CPU and resident GPU routes execute for the same composition/project/backend.

evaluation.decision: No product defect classification, route preference, visual acceptance, or implementation approval.

execution.backend: Python NumPy source-equation model; no Windows UI, application, C++ execution, build, CMake, or tests.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed patch layout, alpha/tone levels, effect controls, backgrounds, hash seed and source hashes.
